## f1 · Find times (Sera's tool)
Sera calls this before naming any time. It asks **d0** (`availability`), the same rules as the booking form, so the chat can't offer a closed day or a taken time.

If the asked day has no times, d0 moves to the next day that has some and says why. Bad dates, unknown doctors and dates past the 30-day window come back as a plain status, never an error.
